name: gradient-spin
description: Gradient matrix loading spinner for React — arrow/diagonal/snake/ripple wavefronts, OKLab-sampled multi-stop gradients, one compositor-only CSS keyframe, zero deps.

paragraphs: A zero-dependency React matrix loading spinner — a grid of cells swept by a gradient wavefront. The cousin of a progress bar's shimmer: cells light up in arrow / diagonal / snake / ripple patterns, colored by a multi-stop gradient sampled in OKLab.
Live demo → gradient-spin.vercel.app · Sister library: gradient-shimmer (same gradient palettes, for text).

opacity-only animation with a negative per-cell delay (delay = distance function over the grid). The spinner keeps ticking even while the main thread is busy with the work you're waiting for — exactly when a spinner matters.
features: One CSS keyframe, compositor-only. Every cell shares a single
Steady-state mount. Negative delays mean the loop is already mid-flight
Gradient-true cells. Colors are sampled from the gradient in OKLab
No CSS import. Styles are injected once at runtime (useInsertionEffect,
